notes: Adds experimental audio-only YouTube search, links and playlists on Android using YouTube.js, with no video panel during games. Human poker Fold always asks for confirmation. YouTube changes or regional restrictions may temporarily prevent streaming; provider fixes arrive through Qurio app updates.
